# Security Policy Mixed Quality

Organization: Example GmbH
Version: 1.4
Review date: June 2026
Document owner: Security Lead role

## Risk Management

The risk management process is documented and implemented for critical services.
The Security Lead role owns the risk assessment, reviews the risk register quarterly,
and records approved treatment actions in the governance log.

| Area | Control evidence | Frequency |
|---|---|---|
| risk assessment | approved risk register entry and review notes | quarterly |
| access control | exception report and owner approval | monthly |

## Access Control

Access control follows least privilege. The IT Operations team performs an access review
every month, records removed accounts, and keeps the export as evidence.

## Known Weak Area

Supplier security is planned only for low-risk vendors. The supplier review procedure is
not documented and the contractual security owner is not defined.
